# Google GenAI SDK Cookbook

> Hands-on bilingual Jupyter & Google Colab notebooks covering the unified google-genai SDK across Google AI Studio, Vertex AI, Streaming, ThinkingConfig…

## Notebooks (en)

- [01. Hello World with Google AI Studio](https://examples.drawlib.com/google-genai/en/01_ai_studio_quickstart.html): This cookbook uses [jupyter].setup_packages in drawlib.toml to automatically prepend !pip install -q google-genai at the top of every generated notebook…
- [02. Hello World with Vertex AI & Backend Selection](https://examples.drawlib.com/google-genai/en/02_vertex_ai_quickstart.html): The core architectural advantage of the unified google-genai SDK is that only the genai.Client(...) initialization differs between Google AI Studio and…
- [03. Streaming Delivery & ThinkingConfig Control](https://examples.drawlib.com/google-genai/en/03_streaming_and_thinking.html): Interactive AI applications on gemini-3.8-flash optimize perceived responsiveness along two independent axes: streaming delivery (generate_content_stream)…
- [04. Type-Safe Structured Outputs with Pydantic](https://examples.drawlib.com/google-genai/en/04_structured_outputs.html): Prompting an LLM to "reply only in JSON" often breaks in production when responses include conversational preambles, trailing commas, or `json Markdown code…
- [05. Multi-Turn Chat & Python Function Calling](https://examples.drawlib.com/google-genai/en/05_chat_and_function_calling.html): The google-genai SDK turns stateless model requests into stateful, tool-augmented assistants using two built-in primitives: client.chats.create() for…

- [05. マルチターン Chat と Function Calling（ツール連携）](https://examples.drawlib.com/google-genai/ja/05_chat_and_function_calling.html): google-genai SDK は、ステートレスなモデル呼び出しを「状態とツールを備えた実用的なアシスタント」へと進化させる2つの標準プリミティブを提供しています。会話履歴を自動管理する client.chats.create() と、Python の型ヒントおよび docstring…
